title: Launch cadence & comms matrix for SDK/API surface: function calling, structured output, streaming
creator: Maya Chen
description: Coordinated launch plan for SDK and API surface updates that ship function calling, structured output schema support, and streaming primitives. Deliverables: release notes templates, localized sample kit (JS/Python/Go), cross-team comms matrix, staged rollout schedule (canary -> gradual -> GA), rollback/runbook, and telemetry gating criteria. Goal: customers can adopt with minimal migration friction, docs and sample code demonstrate best practices for structured outputs and streaming integration, and telemetry validates no significant latency/quality regressions.
acceptance_criteria: Release notes template created and approved by PM + Legal
Sample kit (JS/Python/Go) includes at least 3 example workflows: function calling orchestration, structured JSON schema parsing, and streaming incremental UI integration
Docs pages merged and linked from SDK home with quickstart snippets
Canary rollout plan with clear telemetry SLOs and abort thresholds documented
Localization pack prepared for EN/FR/DE/JP with code comments and prompt translations
Cross-team comms matrix completed with owners and send dates for email/blog/tweet/partner notes

risks: Streaming changes may increase connection counts and pressure on gateway; mitigation: staged concurrency caps and synthetic load tests
Structured-output schema misuse by customers leading to data quality regressions; mitigation: add explicit schema validation examples and evaluation tests
Localization delays could push localized release by 2 weeks; mitigation: ship EN GA first and backfill localized assets as patches
Backward compatibility: older SDK versions may not support new streaming API; mitigation: provide compatibility shims and clear deprecation timeline
notes_for_launch_day: Run synthetic smoke tests against canary after 10 minutes and 1 hour marks
Confirm telemetry dashboards are receiving events for generation_latency, streaming_errors, parsed_schema_failure_rate
Ops on-call to monitor rollback thresholds and runbook checklist
DevRel to publish blog + example walkthrough and pin on Discord/Community channels
Support to publish KB article and migration checklist for customers
